# A template holding no dynamic or control flow action has nothing to mutate.
#
# Reporting that as "0 mutants, 0 missed" and exiting zero would read as the
# tests catching everything, which is the most misleading answer this tool can
# give. Finding nothing to ask about is an error instead.

! muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello!{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Greeting struct {
	Name string
	Loud bool
}

func Render(w io.Writer, greeting Greeting) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", greeting)
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreeting(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Render(&buf, Greeting{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want-err.txt --
Error: no mutations available: the 1 template(s) reached hold no dynamic or control flow actions, so a run would report every mutant killed without testing anything
